Wait, let me make sure I got that right. The play starts with the feud between the Montagues and Capulets. Romeo meets Juliet at a party, they exchange words, and decide to marry in secret. Juliet fakes her death to escape the arranged marriage, but Romeo hears about her death and kills himself. When Juliet wakes up, she sees him dead and also kills herself. Their deaths make their parents realize the futility of the feud, so they reconcile. 

So, in three sentences: It's about Romeo and Juliet, two lovers from feuding families who die tragically, leading their families to end their conflict.

Their suicides result in the reconciliation of their feuding families, ending the long-standing conflict. The play highlights themes of love, fate, and the consequences of family feuds.
